body.purpose: Default UI and reading in Open Sans.

label.purpose: Button chrome: 0.85rem bold uppercase. Not for task titles.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Uppercase Owned Blue tool; white label is hardcoded, not --white.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.25rem; min-height: 34px; padding: 0 0.5rem; border: 0; border-radius: 4px; background: var(--primary, #1973ff); color: #ffffff; font-family: 'Open Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 0.85rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-transform: uppercase; line-height: 1; box-shadow: 0 3px 6px hsla(220, 8.9%, 46.1%, 0.12), 0 2px 4px hsla(220, 8.9%, 46.1%, 0.10); cursor: pointer; transition: all 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--primary-dark, #013992); box-shadow: 0 10px 20px hsla(220, 8.9%, 46.1%, 0.12), 0 3px 6px hsla(220, 8.9%, 46.1%, 0.08); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--primary, #1973ff); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { box-shadow: 0 1px 3px hsla(220, 8.9%, 46.1%, 0.12), 0 1px 2px hsla(220, 8.9%, 46.1%, 0.24); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Outlined-looking fill on Paper White; same uppercase tool language.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.25rem; min-height: 34px; padding: 0 0.5rem; border: 0; border-radius: 4px; background: var(--scheme-main, #ffffff); color: var(--grey-900, #111827); font-family: 'Open Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 0.85rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-transform: uppercase; line-height: 1; box-shadow: 0 3px 6px hsla(220, 8.9%, 46.1%, 0.12), 0 2px 4px hsla(220, 8.9%, 46.1%, 0.10); cursor: pointer; transition: all 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { color: var(--grey-600, #4b5563); box-shadow: 0 10px 20px hsla(220, 8.9%, 46.1%, 0.12), 0 3px 6px hsla(220, 8.9%, 46.1%, 0.08); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--primary, #1973ff); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { box-shadow: 0 1px 3px hsla(220, 8.9%, 46.1%, 0.12), 0 1px 2px hsla(220, 8.9%, 46.1%, 0.24); }

components.name: Tertiary Button
components.description: Text tool: no fill, no shadow, Cool Paper wash on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-tertiary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 34px; padding: 0 0.5rem; border: 0; border-radius: 4px; background: transparent; color: var(--text, #4a4a4a); font-family: 'Open Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 0.85rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-transform: uppercase; line-height: 1; box-shadow: none; cursor: pointer; transition: all 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-tertiary:hover { background: var(--grey-100, #f3f4f6); box-shadow: none; } .ds-btn-tertiary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--primary, #1973ff); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Hairline field; mouse focus has no halo, keyboard focus does.
components.css: .ds-input { display: block; width: 100%; height: 2.5rem; padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem; border: 1px solid var(--grey-200, #e5e7eb); border-radius: 4px; background: var(--scheme-main, #ffffff); color: var(--text-strong, #363636); font-family: 'Open Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.5; box-shadow: none; transition: all 150ms ease; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #6e6e6e; } .ds-input:hover { border-color: var(--border-hover, #b5b5b5); } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--primary, #1973ff); box-shadow: none; } .ds-input:focus-visible { box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px hsla(217deg, 98%, 53%, 0.5); }

components.name: Card
components.html:
Project
Next actions stay on the bench.
components.css: .ds-card { background: var(--white, #ffffff); color: var(--text, #4a4a4a); border: 1px solid var(--card-border-color, #e5e7eb); border-radius: 4px; box-shadow: 0 3px 6px hsla(220, 8.9%, 46.1%, 0.12), 0 2px 4px hsla(220, 8.9%, 46.1%, 0.10); max-width: 100%; overflow: hidden; } .ds-card-header { padding: 0.75rem 1rem; font-family: 'Open Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; color: var(--text-strong, #363636); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--card-border-color, #e5e7eb); } .ds-card-body { padding: 1.5rem; font-family: 'Open Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.5; }

components.name: Sidebar Nav Item
components.description: Square tool-rack row; exact-active turns Owned Blue.
components.html: Inbox
components.css: .ds-nav-item { display: flex; align-items: center; height: 44px; padding: 0.75rem 0.5rem 0.75rem 0.25rem; border-radius: 0; color: var(--grey-700, #374151); font-family: 'Open Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; text-decoration: none; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; transition: all 0.2s ease; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: var(--white, #ffffff); } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--primary, #1973ff); outline-offset: -2px; } .ds-nav-icon { width: 1rem; height: 1rem; margin-inline-end: 0.5rem; color: var(--grey-400, #9ca3af); flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-nav-item-active { color: var(--primary, #1973ff); } .ds-nav-item-active .ds-nav-icon { color: var(--primary, #1973ff); }

components.name: Label Chip
components.description: Task label; color is the label hex, not Owned Blue.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 0.25rem 0.5rem; border-radius: 4px; background: var(--grey-200, #e5e7eb); color: var(--grey-800, #1f2937); font-family: 'Open Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 0.85rem; line-height: 1.25; } .ds-chip:hover { filter: brightness(0.96); } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--primary, #1973ff); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Kanban Card
components.description: Signature ticket: xs shadow, Open Sans title, not a marketing tile.
components.css: .ds-kanban { display: block; background: var(--white, #ffffff); border-radius: 4px; box-shadow: 0 1px 3px hsla(220, 8.9%, 46.1%, 0.12), 0 1px 2px hsla(220, 8.9%, 46.1%, 0.24); padding: 0.75rem; font-size: 0.9rem; cursor: pointer; overflow: hidden; } .ds-kanban:hover { box-shadow: 0 3px 6px hsla(220, 8.9%, 46.1%, 0.12), 0 2px 4px hsla(220, 8.9%, 46.1%, 0.10); } .ds-kanban:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--primary, #1973ff); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-kanban-title { margin: 0; font-family: 'Open Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 0.85rem; font-weight: 400; color: var(--text-strong, #363636); } .ds-kanban-meta { margin-top: 0.25rem; font-family: 'Open Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 0.85rem; color: var(--text-muted, #626875); }

narrative.overview:
This is a task surface, not a brand film. The room is a quiet operator’s bench: dense, scan-first, almost no personality except the Vikunja mark. Tools sit where the hand expects them. Owned Blue is the wrench — the one loud object on the bench — not a wash of chrome.

Personality lives in precise details, not decoration. Headings wear Quicksand at regular weight. Body copy is Open Sans. Primary actions are tactile and confident: short, uppercase, slightly lifted. Everything else recedes into Cool Paper greys so lists, boards, and the next task stay readable. Light and dark are the same workshop with the lights flipped; tokens invert, identity does not.

Confirmed visual rejections: no second display face, no rebrand of the logo or name, no marketing-airy “soft SaaS” padding that fights the density of list and kanban, no replacing the 4px radius language with pills-on-everything.
keyCharacteristics: One accent (Owned Blue) for action and “you are here”
Cool Paper neutrals; dark mode inverts the same grey ramp
Quicksand for headings, Open Sans for work
4px corners, 1px borders, shadows that mark lift not luxury

rules.name: The One Tool Rule
rules.body: Owned Blue is for actions, links, and “you are here.” It is not a background wash, not a hero gradient, and not a second palette. If a screen is mostly blue, the bench is gone.

rules.name: The Button-White Rule
rules.body: Primary (and solid danger) label color is button-text (#ffffff), never --white. --white follows the grey ramp in dark mode and would disappear on Owned Blue.

rules.name: The Quicksand Door Rule
rules.body: Quicksand is for headings, the wordmark-adjacent chrome, and editable titles. Do not set body copy, table cells, or kanban card titles in Quicksand.

rules.name: The Uppercase Tool Rule
rules.body: Uppercase is for buttons (and similarly tool-like chrome). Do not uppercase task titles, project names, or running text.

rules.name: The Border-Plus-Lift Rule
rules.body: Every resting card gets the hairline. Shadows step up on hover or overlay and step down on press (xs). Do not remove the border and “float” the card on shadow alone. Do not stack lg on ordinary list chrome.

rules.name: The Four-Pixel Rule
rules.body: 4px for controls, cards, inputs, tags. Full circles for people and color dots. No 16px “modern app” rounding on the bench.

dos: Do keep the Vikunja wordmark and Owned Blue as the only brand signals.
Do invert --grey-50…900 in dark mode rather than inventing a second palette.
Do put new reusable color on :root HSL components (-h/-s/-l) so dark mode can change one dimension.
Do use logical properties for spacing (margin-inline, padding-block).
Do honor prefers-reduced-motion wherever motion is added (150ms ease is the incumbent duration).
Do prefix any Tailwind utility with tw-.
donts: Don't rebrand, replace Quicksand/Open Sans, or introduce a display serif.
Don't paint large surfaces with Owned Blue (The One Tool Rule).
Don't use --white for text on primary buttons.
Don't uppercase task or project titles.
Don't drop the 1px card border in favor of shadow-only lift.
Don't round past 4px except for avatars, bubbles, and spinners.
Don't author a new locale palette or “premium dark” that ignores the inverted grey ramp.
